arabic_text: يَا أَللهُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ،
transliteration: yā allāhu alladhī lā yakhfā ʿalayhi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fi as-sama'i
english_text: O God, from whom nothing is concealed in earth or heaven!

arabic_text: وَكَيْفَ يَخْفى عَلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي مَا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُ؟
transliteration: wa kayfa yakhfa ʿalayka yā ilāhī mā anta khalaqtahu?
english_text: How should what Thou hast created, my God, be concealed from Thee?

arabic_text: وَكَيْفَ لاَ تُحْصِي مَا أَنْتَ صَنَعْتَهُ؟
transliteration: wa kayfa lā tuḥṣī mā anta ṣanʿatahu?
english_text: How shouldst Thou not number what Thou hast made?

arabic_text: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَغِيبُ عَنْكَ مَا أَنْتَ تُدَبِّرُهُ؟
transliteration: aw kayfa yaghību ʿanka mā anta tudabbiruhu?
english_text: How should what Thou governest be absent from Thee?

arabic_text: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَهْرُبَ مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ حَياةَ لَهُ إلاَّ بِرِزْقِكَ؟
transliteration: aw kayfa yastaṭīʿu an yahru ba minka manlā ḥayātahū illā birizqik?
english_text: How should one who has no life except through Thy provision have the ability to flee from Thee?

arabic_text: أَوْ كَيْفَ يَنْجُو مِنْكَ مَنْ لاَ مَذْهَبَ لَهُ فِي غَيْرِ مُلْكِكَ؟
transliteration: aw kaifa yanju minka man laa madhhaba lahu fee ghayri mulkika?
english_text: How should one who has no road except in Thy kingdom escape from Thee?

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ! أَخْشى خَلْقِكَ لَكَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكَ، وَأَخْضَعُهُمْ لَكَ أَعْمَلُهُمْ بِطَاعَتِكَ، وَأَهْوَنُهُمْ عَلَيْكَ مَنْ أَنْتَ تَرْزُقُهُ وَهُوَ يَعْبُدُ غَيْرَكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka! akhsha khalkika lak, aʿlamuhum bika waʾakhḍaʿuhum laka aʿmaluhum biṭāʿatik wa-ahwanuhum 'alayka man anta tarzuquhu wahua ya'budu ghayrak
english_text: Glory be to Thee! He among Thy creatures who fears Thee most knows Thee best, he among them most bent in humility is most active in obeying Thee, and he among them whom Thou providest while he worships another is most contemptible before Thee!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ! لاَ يُنْقِصُ سُلْطَانَكَ مَنْ أَشْرَكَ بِكَ، وَكَذَّبَ رُسُلَكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka! lā yunqisu sulṭānaka man ashra-ka bika, wa kadhdhaba rusulaka
english_text: Glory be to Thee! He who associates others with Thee and denies Thy messengers diminishes not Thy authority.

arabic_text: وَلَيْسَ يَسْتَطِيعُ مَنْ كَرِهَ قَضَآءَكَ أَنْ يَرُدَّ أَمْرَكَ،
transliteration: wa-laysa yastatiʿu man kariha qadāʾaka an yarudda amrak
english_text: He who dislikes Thy decree cannot reject Thy command.

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَمْتَنِعُ مِنْكَ مَنْ كَذَّبَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa lā yamtaniʿu minka man kadhdhaba biqudratika
english_text: He who denies Thy power keeps himself not away from Thee.

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَفُوتُكَ مَنْ عَبَدَ غَيْرَكَ،
transliteration: wala yafutuka man ʿabada ghayraka
english_text: He who worships other than Thee escapes Thee not.

arabic_text: وَلاَ يُعَمَّرُ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَآءَكَ.
transliteration: wa lā yuʿammaru fī al-dunyā man kariha liqāʾaka
english_text: He who dislikes meeting Thee will not be given endless life in this world.

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ! مَا أَعْظَمَ شَأْنَكَ، وَأَقْهَرَ سُلْطَانَكَ، وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّتَكَ، وَأَنْفَذَ أَمْرَكَ!
transliteration: subḥānaka! mā ʾaʿẓama shaʾnaka, wa aqhar sultanaka waʾashadda quwwataka, waʾanfadaḏa amraka!
english_text: Glory be to Thee! How mighty is Thy station, overpowering Thy authority, intense Thy strength, penetrating Thy command!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ! قَضَيْتَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ الْمَوْتَ: مَنْ وَحَّدَكَ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ بِكَ،
transliteration: subḥānaka! qaḍayta ʿalā jamīʿi khalqika al-mawt man wahaḍaka wa man kafara bika
english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thou hast decreed death for all Thy creatures, both him who professes Thy Unity and him who disbelieves in Thee;

arabic_text: وَكُلٌّ ذَائِقُ المَوْتِ، وَكُلٌّ صَائِرٌ إلَيْكَ، فَتَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ،
transliteration: wa kullun dhāʾiqu al-mawt wa kullun ṣāʾirun ilayka, fatabārakta wa taʿālayta
english_text: each one will taste death, each one will come home to Thee. Blessed art Thou and high exalted!

arabic_text: لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكَ، وَصَدَّقْتُ رُسُلَكَ وَقَبِلْتُ كِتَابَكَ، وَكَفَرْتُ بِكُلِّ مَعْبُود غَيْرِكَ، وَبَرِئْتُ مِمَّنْ عَبَدَ سِوَاكَ.
transliteration: lā ʾilāha ʾillā ʾant, waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, ʾāmantu bika waṣaddaqtu rusulaka wa qabil tu kitabaka wa kafartu bikulli ma'budin ghayrika wa bariratu mimman ʿabada siwaka
english_text: There is no god but Thou, Thou alone, who hast no associate. I have faith in Thee, I attest to Thy messengers, I accept Thy Book, I disbelieve in every object of worship other than Thee, I am quit of anyone who worships another!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أُصْبحُ وَأُمْسِي مُسْتَقِلاًّ لِعَمَلِي، مُعْتَرِفاً بِذَنْبِي، مُقِرَّاً بِخَطَايَايَ،
transliteration: allāhumma innī uṣbiḥu wa umsī mustaqillan li ʿamalī muʿtarifan biðanbi, muqirran bikhataayaaya
english_text: O God, I rise in the morning and enter the evening making little of my good works, confessing my sins, admitting my offenses;

arabic_text: أَنَا بِإسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي ذَلِيلٌ،
transliteration: ana biisrafi 'ala nafsi dhalilun
english_text: I am abased because of my prodigality against myself.

arabic_text: عَمَلِي أَهْلَكَنِي، وَهَوَايَ أَرْدَانِي، وَشَهَوَاتِي حَرَمَتْنِي.
transliteration: ʿamalī ahlakani, wa hawāy ardānī wa shahawātī ḥaramatnī
english_text: My works have destroyed me, my caprice has ruined me, my passions have deprived me.

arabic_text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ سُؤالَ مَنْ نَفْسُهُ لاَهِيَةٌ لِطُولِ أَمَلِهِ، وَبَدَنُهُ غَافِلٌ لِسُكُونِ عُرُوقِهِ، وَقَلْبُهُ مَفْتُونٌ بِكَثْرَةِ النِّعَمِ عَلَيْهِ، وَفِكْرُهُ قَلِيلٌ لِمَا هُوَ صَائِرٌ إلَيْهِ،
transliteration: fa as'aluka ya mawlaya suʾālan man nafsuhu lāhiyatun liṭūli amalih wa badanuhu ghāfilun lisukūni ʿurūqih wa qalbuhu maftūnun bikathrat al-niʿami ʿalayhi wa-fikruhu qalilun lima huwa saiirun ilayhi
english_text: So I ask Thee, my Master, the asking of him whose soul is diverted by his drawn out expectations, whose body is heedless because of the stillness of his veins, whose heart is entranced by the multitude of favours done for him, whose reflection is little concerning that to which he is coming home;

arabic_text: سُؤَالَ مَنْ قَدْ غَلَبَ عَلَيْهِ الاَمَلُ، وَفَتَنَهُ الْهَوى، وَاسْتَمْكَنَتْ مِنْهُ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَظَلَّهُ الاَجَلُ، سُؤَالَ مَنِ اسْتَكْثَرَ ذُنُوبَهُ، وَاعْتَرَفَ بِخَطِيئَتِهِ، سُؤَالَ مَنْ لاَ رَبَّ لَهُ غَيْرُكَ،
transliteration: suʾāla man qad ghalaba ʿalayhi al-amalُ wa fata nahul hawa, wastamkanat minhu al dunya wa aẓallahu al-ajalu, suʾāla mani-stakthara dhunūbahū waʿtarafa bi-khaṭīʾatih, suʾila man lā rabbahu ghayruka
english_text: the asking of him whom false expectation has overcome, caprice has entranced, and this world has mastered, and over whom death has cast its shadow; the asking of him who makes much of his sins and confesses his offense; the asking of him who has no Lord but Thou,

arabic_text: وَلاَ وَلِيَّ لَهُ دُونَكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقِذَ لَهُ مِنْكَ، وَلاَ مَلْجَأَ لَهُ مِنْكَ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ .
transliteration: walā waliyya lahu dūnaka, walā munqiẓa lahu minka wa la malja'a lahu minka illa ilayk
english_text: no friend besides Thee, no one to deliver him from Thee, and no asylum from Thee except in Thee.

arabic_text: إلهِي أسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ الْـوَاجِبِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ، وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيْمِ الَّذِي أَمَرْتَ رَسُولَكَ أَنْ يُسَبِّحَكَ بِهِ، وَبِجَلاَلِ وَجْهِكَ الْكَرِيمِ الذِي لاَ يَبْلى وَلاَ يَتَغَيَّرُ، وَلاَ يَحُولُ وَلاَ يَفْنى،
transliteration: 'ilaahi as'aluka bihaqqikal-waajibil 'alaa jamee'i khalqik wa bismika al-ʿaẓīmi alladhī amarta rasūlaka an yusabbiḥaka bihi wa-bi-jalāli wajhika al-karīmi al-ladhī lā yabla wala yataghayyar, wala yahul, wala yafna
english_text: My God, I ask Thee by Thy right incumbent upon all Thy creatures, by Thy mighty name with which Thou commanded Thy messenger to glorify Thee, and by the majesty of Thy generous face, which ages not, nor changes, nor alters, nor passes away,

arabic_text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد، وَأَنْ تُغْنِيَنِي عَنْ كُلِّ شَيْء بِعِبادَتِكَ، وَأَنْ تُسَلِّيَ نَفْسِيْ عَنِ الدُّنْيَا بِمَخَافَتِكَ، وَأَنْ تُثْنِيَنِي بِالْكَثِيْرِ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: an tuṣalliya ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad wa ʾan tughniyani ʿan kulli shayʾ biʿibadatika wa-an tusalliya nafsi 'anid-dunyā bi-makhāfatika wa an tuthniyani bil-kathiri min karamatika bi-rahmatika
english_text: that Thou blessest Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, that Thou freest me from need for all things through worshipping Thee, that Thou distractest my soul from this world through fear of Thee, and that Thou turnest me back toward Thy abundant generosity through Thy mercy!

arabic_text: فَإلَيْكَ أَفِرُّ، و مِنْكَ أَخَافُ، وَبِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَرْجُو، وَلَكَ أَدْعُو، وَإلَيْكَ أَلْجَأُ، وَبِكَ أَثِقُ، وَإيَّاكَ أَسْتَعِينُ، وَبِكَ أُؤمِنُ، وَعَلَيْكَ أَتَوَكَّلُ،
transliteration: fa-ilayka a'firru, wa minka akhafu, wa bika astaghithu wa-iyyāka arjū, wa-laka adʿū, wa-ilayka aljaʾu wa-bika athiqu, wa-iyyaka astaʿinu, wa-bika u'minu wa ʿalayka atawakkal
english_text: To Thee I flee, Thee I fear, from Thee I seek aid, in Thee I hope, Thee I supplicate, in Thee I seek asylum, in Thee I trust, from Thee I ask help, in Thee I have faith, in Thee I have placed my confidence,

arabic_text: وَعَلَى جُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ أَتَّكِلُ.
transliteration: wa'ala jūdika wa karamika atakillu
english_text: and upon Thy munificence and Thy generosity I rely.
